hero_kpi_rationale: SPIE is a nonprofit organization focused on community. The amount supported (nearly $4M in 2022) is a key indicator of its impact and business model based on reinvestment in optics and photonics research and education.

kpis.name: Community Support
kpis.explanation: Amount spent by SPIE to support the community (scholarships, grants, programs).
kpis.description: In 2022, SPIE spent nearly $4 million in community support, including scholarships, grants, and educational programs.
kpis.signal: SPIE reinvests heavily in the scientific community.

kpis.name: Scholarships Awarded
kpis.explanation: Total amount of scholarships awarded by SPIE to students worldwide.
kpis.description: In 2022, SPIE awarded over $300,000 in scholarships to students from 28 countries.
kpis.signal: Strong commitment to training future scientists.

kpis.name: Digital Library Access
kpis.explanation: Number of countries benefiting from free access to the SPIE Digital Library through the SHARE (SPIE Helping Advance Research Everywhere) program.
kpis.description: The SHARE program provided free access to the SPIE Digital Library in 111 countries in 2022.
kpis.signal: Global reach of knowledge sharing in optics and photonics.

kpis.name: Membership
kpis.description: SPIE membership reached a record level at Photonics West 2023, shortly after the end of 2022.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of community engagement within the global optics and photonics community.

kpis.name: Publications Added
kpis.explanation: Total number of new publications added to the SPIE Digital Library in 2022, including conference papers, presentation recordings, journal articles, and eBook chapters.
kpis.description: In 2022, 22,451 new publications were added to the SPIE Digital Library, including 16,500 conference papers, 8,200 presentation recordings, 1,800 journal articles, and 530 eBook chapters.
kpis.signal: Ongoing growth of the world's largest research repository in optics and photonics.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €10.3B in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €2.8B in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €0.79B in the latest year

evidence: No reference to AI, generative models, or APIs in the document.
